bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/accessory_access.rs (bifrost_app::accessory_access), springboard/core/src/accessory_manager.rs, springboard/core/src/usb_descriptors.rs; related: springboard/src/bare/input.rs (evdev device discovery), springboard/src/bare/docbroker.rs (file grants), springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (permission manifest)
summary: Accessory Access is a USB-only framework: an app registers listeners that match connected USB accessories through IOUSBHost and receives attach and detach events. BifrOSt has an SDK surface for the accessory manager, the accessory object, matching criteria, events and errors, built on a pure model. Nothing reports real bus attach or detach to it, the sandbox does not bind USB device nodes, and no USB permission grant exists.

features.note: built on parity/team-k-accessory-access; not yet verified on Midget. Apps reach the manager through the SDK module; no bus source calls attach or detach yet.
built on parity/team-k-accessory-access; not yet verified on Midget. The device descriptors, configuration and strings are public fields for apps. No bus source fills them yet.
built on parity/team-k-accessory-access; not yet verified on Midget. Criteria select by vendor, product, class, subclass and protocol, and by interface.
built on parity/team-k-accessory-access; not yet verified on Midget. Events are queued per listener key; no bus hotplug source feeds them yet.

features.note: Apps match accessories by criteria and receive attach and detach events, and the device browser reports which USB devices came and went, both tested inline in their pure models. Gap: the sandbox binds no USB device nodes, so no app reaches a real accessory, and the shell supplies the bus snapshots.

features.note: Wave 3 (theme-16, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. docbroker grants file access only. The permission manifest has no USB device permission, so an app cannot request one.
built on parity/team-k-accessory-access; not yet verified on Midget. Error values have readable messages and are exposed to apps.

gaps: No bus source calls attach and detach for USB accessories, so no app receives real hotplug events yet.
No USB device permission in the app permission manifest (springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs), and no grant flow comparable to docbroker.rs for USB.
The accessory object's descriptors come from the caller; nothing reads them from a device.
No USB device nodes are bound into the app sandbox, so a listener cannot match a real accessory from an app.
